scenarios.name: unchanged
scenarios.doc: A reload of an unchanged file writes no state: only `automation_reloaded`. The triggers stay attached.

scenarios.name: action_changed
scenarios.doc: One automation's action changes: it is removed and made again (its `last_triggered` restored), the other is left alone. The new action runs, the old trigger is gone.

scenarios.name: trigger_changed
scenarios.doc: The trigger moves to another entity: the old entity no longer fires it.

scenarios.name: renamed
scenarios.doc: A new alias: the entity id stays, the registry's original name follows.

scenarios.name: added
scenarios.doc: A new automation with an id gets a registry row and an entity id from its alias.

scenarios.name: removed
scenarios.doc: An automation taken out of the file: its entity goes, its triggers with it.

scenarios.name: removed_then_back
scenarios.doc: Taken out and put back by two reloads: it keeps its entity id and comes back with what it had.

scenarios.name: off_then_edited
scenarios.doc: An automation turned off, then changed: it comes back off, with its `last_triggered`.

scenarios.name: initial_state
scenarios.doc: `initial_state` in the new config wins over what the old entity had.

scenarios.name: running
scenarios.doc: A run waiting on a trigger when its automation changes is stopped; the unchanged automation's run goes on.

scenarios.name: running_unchanged_reload
scenarios.doc: A reload that changes nothing leaves a waiting run alone.

scenarios.name: single_id
scenarios.doc: `id` reloads that automation only: the other's change in the file waits for its own reload.

scenarios.name: single_id_unchanged_and_unknown
scenarios.doc: `id` of an unchanged automation, and of none: nothing but the event.

scenarios.name: single_id_added
scenarios.doc: `id` of an automation new in the file adds it.

scenarios.name: single_id_removed
scenarios.doc: `id` of an automation no longer in the file removes it.

scenarios.name: no_id
scenarios.doc: Automations without an id match by name and config wherever they are in the list: reordered ones are kept, a changed one is made again.

scenarios.name: no_alias
scenarios.doc: Without an alias the name is the place in the list, so moving it is a change.

scenarios.name: becomes_invalid
scenarios.doc: A change that doesn't validate: the automation is `unavailable`; fixed, it comes back as it was before.

expected.msg: Automation with alias 'Hall motion' failed to setup triggers and has been disabled: required key not provided @ data['entity_id']. Got None

scenarios.name: invalid_unchanged
scenarios.doc: An invalid automation that is unchanged is left alone too.

expected.msg: Automation with alias 'Bad' failed to setup triggers and has been disabled: required key not provided @ data['entity_id']. Got None
Automation with alias 'Bad' failed to setup triggers and has been disabled: required key not provided @ data['entity_id']. Got None

scenarios.name: duplicate_id
scenarios.doc: A reload that brings a second automation with an id already in use.

expected.msg: Platform automation does not generate unique IDs. ID hall already exists - ignoring automation.hall_motion

scenarios.name: same_alias
scenarios.doc: A new automation whose alias is taken gets the next free entity id.

scenarios.name: emptied
scenarios.doc: An empty file removes every automation; filled again, they return.

scenarios.name: broken_yaml
scenarios.doc: A file that doesn't parse: the reload fails and nothing changes; mended, the next reload reads it.

expected.msg:
Failed to load configuration: while parsing a flow sequence
  in "<config>/automations.yaml", line 2, column 10
expected ',' or ']', but got '<stream end>'
  in "<config>/automations.yaml", line 3, column 1

scenarios.name: bad_data
scenarios.doc: `reload`'s schema: `id` must be a string, and nothing else is allowed.

expected.msg: expected str for dictionary value @ data['id']

scenarios.name: twice
scenarios.doc: Two reloads called together, the file changed once.
